title: Compressed Traffic Assignment with the Augmented Lagrangian Method
summary: We consider large-scale traffic assignment problems and develop a path-based compression framework. In particular, we partition paths into major and minor paths according to nominal path flows and a prescribed threshold, and retain the major paths explicitly. For the minor paths, we use reference flows derived from nominal-flow information and represent deviations using a truncated singular value decomposition of the minor path-link incidence matrix.
